observations.title: Fuego volcano (Guatemala)
observations.description: The Instituto Nacional de Sismología, Vulcanologia, Meteorologia e Hidrología (INSIVUMEH) reported that eruptive activity at Fuego continued during 11-18 November. Daily explosions recorded by the seismic network, at rates of 1-8 per hour, generated gas-and-ash plumes that rose as high as 1.2 km above the summit and mainly drifted as far as 40 km N, NE, and E; plumes drifted S and SW during 17-28 November. Weather clouds sometimes obscured visual observations. Shock waves and rumbling sounds from explosions were reported almost daily. Explosions also often ejected incandescent material, sometimes as high as 300 m above the summit, and onto the flanks, resulting in incandescent block avalanches that descended the Seca (W), Ceniza (SSW), El Jute (ESE), and Las Lajas (SE) drainages, sometimes reaching vegetated areas. Minor ashfall was reported in El Porvenir (11 km SW), La Candelaria, Alotenango (8 km ENE), Ciudad Vieja (14 km NE), Antigua Guatemala (18 km NE), and surrounding communities during 12-13 November. Source: Instituto Nacional de Sismologia, Vulcanologia, Meteorologia, e Hidrologia (INSIVUMEH)
